summary: Regression tests for the LLM model rename fix (claude-sonnet-4-20250514 -> claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). Verified 19 corrections (18 in server.py, 1 in evolutionary_qa_system.py). All 4 previously-broken AI endpoints now return valid 200 responses: /api/chat (IA Spécialisée), /api/ia-evolutif/dialoguer (IA Évolutive, after /api/ia-evolutif/initialiser-auto), /api/ia-socratique/challenger (IA Socratique with reflexion_utilisateur only - note: request body does NOT include an 'affirmation' field despite reviewer note), and /api/gabriel/ask (baseline, still working). 5/5 pytest assertions passed in 28.5s.
critical_code_review_comments: grep confirms all 18 with_model() calls in server.py + 1 in evolutionary_qa_system.py use the corrected model id 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'. No stale occurrences of the invalid 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' remain.

Note: The review request mentions IA Socratique needs fields 'affirmation' AND 'reflexion_utilisateur', but the Pydantic model DialogueSocratiqueRequest (server.py L3516) only defines reflexion_utilisateur + optional contexte_session. Endpoint works fine with just reflexion_utilisateur. If an 'affirmation' field is expected by the frontend, the backend schema needs updating - otherwise the reviewer's note is inaccurate.
server.py has grown to 6799 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (persistent finding from earlier iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_llm_model_fix_iteration8.py covers all 4 AI endpoints affected by the model rename. Reuse as regression suite for any future LLM-related changes. LLM calls average ~5-7s each; total suite ~28s.
rca of the issue: Anthropic model id 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' did not exist on the Emergent LLM proxy, causing every with_model()/LlmChat call using it to fail at inference time. Only Gabriel (which uses a different code path / correct id) was unaffected. Fix: renamed 19 occurrences to the valid 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'. Verified via live end-to-end 200 responses on /api/chat, /api/ia-evolutif/dialoguer, /api/ia-socratique/challenger, /api/gabriel/ask.
